description:
Report the room, a member (member_id, theirs) or a message (cursor) to Bellman's operators. The room's creator also sees a report about a member or a message other than its own, never who filed it. The person reported is not told.

Args: session_id, member_id or cursor, reason, note
Returns: { report_id, folded } — folded: true when you reported this already and it is still open; nothing new was filed.
Errors: rate_limited (retry_after) past 10 reports a day; refused without a seat held now or before, unless the room is public.

room_id.description: session_id under another name, for a host that reserves it.

name: bellman_report
title: Report a room, a member or a message
